title: Tunisian Smoked Meat Tagine
description: A traditional Tunisian dish made with slow-cooked smoked meat and aromatic spices. This rich and flavorful tagine is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat oil in a large clay pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cinnamon, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add enough water to cover the lamb and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven. Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Slice the lamb against the grain and serve with the juices.
